targetSession.name: ti_dev_session
targetSession.description: Optional authoritative server-side target Session. The production cookie name is __Host-ti_session. A valid principal enriches supported relation/owner fields and becomes the public-read limiter actor.

legacyBearer.description: Optional kill-switched compatibility credential. If accepted it resolves a server-derived viewer; an invalid optional credential that is not stopped by the compatibility layer is treated as anonymous.

legacyFlaskSession.name: session
legacyFlaskSession.description: Optional kill-switched signed Flask Session compatibility credential. Successful first exchange may create bounded authentication runtime state before this catalog read.

LegacySort.name: sort
LegacySort.description: Legacy coercion: trim; popular selects hot, questions selects question count, newest selects latest, and every missing or other value selects latest.

LegacySourceType.name: type
LegacySourceType.description: Exact, untrimmed system or user filters that source; missing and every other value select both sources.

Keyword.name: keyword
Keyword.description: Missing becomes empty. The value is trimmed, lower-cased and internal whitespace is collapsed before literal matching and deterministic search ranking.

x-ti-coercion.wildcardSemantics: Bound parameters keep legacy SQL LIKE percent/underscore wildcard behavior without allowing SQL-fragment injection.

Page.name: page
Page.description: Parsed as an arbitrary-precision base-10 integer. Missing or malformed becomes 1; values below 1 become 1; values above 2147483647 become 2147483647.

LegacyPageSize.name: per_page
LegacyPageSize.description: Parsed as an arbitrary-precision base-10 integer. Missing or malformed becomes 20; zero becomes 12; negatives become 1; positives are capped at 50.

PlazaPageSize.name: per_page
PlazaPageSize.description: Parsed as an arbitrary-precision base-10 integer. Missing, malformed or zero becomes 12; negatives become 1; positives are capped at 50.

BoardId.name: board_id
BoardId.description: Missing, blank, malformed, zero and negative values normalize to no board filter. Positive arbitrary-precision values are capped at Java Long.MAX_VALUE.

HotLimit.name: limit
HotLimit.description: Parsed as an arbitrary-precision base-10 integer. Missing, malformed or zero becomes 5; negatives become 1; positives are capped at 10.

PlazaTab.name: tab
PlazaTab.description: Trim and lower-case. latest, hot, active, featured and questions are recognized; every other value becomes latest.

CardSourceType.name: source_type
CardSourceType.description: A nonempty Flask string-converter segment. After trimming, exact lowercase system selects system; every other nonempty value selects user_public.

BankId.name: bank_id
BankId.description: The valid operation parameter is one or more Unicode decimal digits with General_Category=Nd, matching Werkzeug's nonnegative arbitrary-precision int converter. Arabic-Indic and fullwidth Nd digits reach the handler and normalize to the same integer as their ASCII decimal equivalents. Negative segments and any segment containing a non-Nd code point bypass the handler and return the uncounted converter 404. A converter-valid value above signed 64-bit range is counted and returns the approved fixed safe 500 instead of leaking the legacy conversion exception.

x-ti-coercion.converter: one or more Unicode decimal digits (General_Category=Nd) interpreted as an arbitrary-precision nonnegative integer
x-ti-coercion.unicodeDecimalNormalization: each Nd code point contributes its decimal value; the handler receives the normalized integer
x-ti-coercion.negativeOrContainingNonNd: converter 404 before public-bank limiter, with no rate-limit headers

x-ti-observed-unicode-decimal-cases.legacy: Werkzeug reaches the handler, counts the request and returns the same response body as the corresponding ASCII-decimal path

x-ti-observed-48-digit-cases.legacy: handler reached, limiter counted, two read-only SQL statements, unstable application/json 500 with exception text
x-ti-observed-48-digit-cases.java: resolver and limiter reached, no catalog lookup after range classification, application/json; charset=utf-8 safe 500 with four rate-limit headers

DetailSourceType.name: type
DetailSourceType.description: Trim; exact lowercase system selects system. Missing and every other value select user_public.

VaryOriginCookie.description: Compatibility CORS/cache variance. Golden normalization treats token order as insignificant.

RequestId.description: Effective request identifier, echoed in the body.

RateLimitLimit.description: Effective limit for the reported public-bank fixed window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Remaining requests in the reported window.

RateLimitReset.description: Legacy-compatible reset epoch second: floor((now milliseconds + Redis PTTL) / 1000) + 1.

RetryAfter.description: At least one second until the reported public-bank window or credential-exchange budget resets.

LegacyListSuccess.description: Normalized page with exact filtered total and stable ordering. A beyond-last page has an empty banks array and preserves total/page.

BoardsSuccess.description: Active boards ordered by sort_order ascending, bank_count descending and board ID ascending.

HotSuccess.description: Bounded hot-score ordering without a total-count query.

PlazaListSuccess.description: Normalized full plaza page. A beyond-last page has empty items and preserves exact total and normalized parameters.

SummarySuccess.description: Filtered aggregate with true inclusive rolling-seven-day counts.

DetailSuccess.description: System or user-public detail. Optional accepted identity only enriches relation and user ownership fields.

RateLimited.description: First request beyond the endpoint-and-actor public-read fixed window, or a credential-exchange security budget reached before this operation.

SafeInternalFailure.description: Counted fixed safe response for an unexpected catalog failure. This includes converter-valid arbitrary-precision bank IDs above signed 64-bit range; legacy exception text is never returned.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Stable unavailable response. Snapshot cold/partial/hard-expired is produced after a successful limiter decision; Redis public-rate failure is produced before a decision and has no rate headers; Session/exchange authority may also fail before this operation.

PathFirewallRejected.description: A semicolon-bearing ambiguous path is rejected by StrictHttpFirewall before public route resolution, limiter reservation and MVC invocation.
PathFirewallRejected.x-ti-observed-contract: Only HTTP 400 and zero catalog/limiter interactions are asserted. Body, Content-Type and headers are intentionally unspecified because they were not frozen as compatibility contract.

x-ti-snapshot-state-machine.fresh: complete age from 0 through 300 seconds; serve
x-ti-snapshot-state-machine.softStale: complete age greater than 300 through 900 seconds; serve unchanged and emit internal stale metrics
x-ti-snapshot-state-machine.hardExpired: complete age greater than 900 seconds; stable 503
x-ti-snapshot-state-machine.partialOrInconsistent: marker and projection generation/count/digest/boundary disagreement; stable 503
x-ti-snapshot-state-machine.readiness: not ready for cold, partial/inconsistent or hard-expired state
x-ti-snapshot-state-machine.atomicPublication: metrics, viewer state and complete marker become visible in one PostgreSQL transaction
x-ti-snapshot-state-machine.getIntegrityCheck: constant-size marker plus first/last indexed generation-and-digest boundary samples

x-ti-side-effect-contract.publicRateLimiterSecurityWrites: up to three fixed-window counters for the resolved endpoint and pseudonymous actor; fail-on-first-breach skips longer windows
